newsitem.title: ITALY: Outline of Italy plan ready by end of week - unions.
newsitem.headline: Outline of Italy plan ready by end of week - unions.

text.p: The government will have the outline of its latest three-year economic programme (DPEF) ready by the end of the week, the head of Italy's Cisl union said on Tuesday after a meeting with Prime Minister Romano Prodi.

The centre-left government has pledged to unveil the DPEF by the end of the month. The document will set new deficit/GDP targets for 1998 and is expected to give some indication of planned savings from forthcoming structural reforms.
"The outline of the DPEF will be ready by the end of the week," the Cisl's Sergio D'Antoni told reporters.
D'Antoni and other union leaders met Prodi and senior cabinet ministers on Monday for the first round of talks over a planned reform of the Italian welfare state. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
